success.description: Until the start of your next turn, add {Dc} to any Melee Attack or Ranged Attack actions targeting you or any allies in the same engagement as you. An engaged ally may remove 1 stress from you. Recover fatigue and 1 stress. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 stress to any Ranged Attack actions targeting the ally.
The GM may add 1 recharge marker to any ally of your choice.
